sonnet.problem: The question says "After the wormwood and the poisoned water," which adds a sequence of time. Verses 15-16 give two things the LORD will do and do not say one comes after the other.
sonnet.rule: **Times stay true.** No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess what the people forsook (law, altar or house). Nothing in the earlier cards lets a baker reason to "law", so this tests wording the baker hasn't seen.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The statement says Judah is on the list of those the LORD "will punish" who are "circumcised only in the flesh." That claim comes from verse 25 as well as verse 26, but the card cites only 9:26.
sonnet.rule: A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.
